t: What a woman may not ask for
a: لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تَسْأَلُ طَلاَقَ أُخْتِهَا لِتَسْتَفْرِغَ صَحْفَتَهَا، فَإِنَّمَا لَهَا مَا قُدِّرَ لَهَا
p: Lā yaḥillu li-mraʾatin tasʾala ṭalāqa ukhtihā li-tastafrigha ṣaḥfatahā, fa-innamā lahā mā quddira lahā
m: It is not lawful for a woman to ask for her sister's divorce in order to empty her bowl into her own. She will only have what was decreed for her.
